Subject: Quick intro / Request for demo

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the quick onboarding flow — I signed up for a trial and want to scope a demo for my team at Acme. We have a couple of specific questions about on-prem/private deployment and performance for 2k token contexts. Before committing to a longer demo, would it be possible to do a 15-minute technical triage with an engineer to make sure this is a fit?

We're on Pacific time and could do today after 4pm PT, or tomorrow morning between 9–11am PT.

Best,
Jordan

Thanks for signing up and for the details — really helpful. We can definitely do a short 15-minute technical triage before the full demo. I looped in Logan (our solutions engineer) and Stephanie (your AE) so we can coordinate.

Available slots I can offer right now:
- Today, 4:30–4:45pm PT
- Tomorrow, 9:00–9:15am PT or 10:30–10:45am PT

If any of those work, reply with the best time and Logan will send a calendar invite with a Zoom link and a quick agenda. If you prefer, here's a short Calendly to pick a time: https://calendly.com/redwood/15min-triage?event=ACME-2345
